title: Mars Perseverance Sol 194: Left Mastcam-Z Camera
caption:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its Left Mastcam-Z camera. Mastcam-Z is a pair of cameras located high on the rover's mast.

This image was acquired on Sept. 5, 2021 (Sol 194) at the local mean solar time of 11:11:45.

title: Mars Perseverance Sol 509: Front Left Hazard Avoidance Camera (Hazcam)
caption:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image of the area in front of it using its onboard Front Left Hazard Avoidance Camera A. 

This image was acquired on July 26, 2022 (Sol 509) at the local mean solar time of 15:40:53.
